scenarios.depth_note: tests first-time buyer guidance: exchange choice, order types, fee comparison, beginner mistakes
scenarios.prompt: I've never bought crypto before and I have $500 to put into Bitcoin this week. Walk me through exactly where to buy it, what order type to use, and what fees I'll actually pay.

scenarios.depth_note: tests comparative analysis across platforms with fee/spread tradeoffs
scenarios.prompt: Coinbase is charging me almost $30 in fees every time I buy $1,000 of Ethereum. Compare Coinbase, Kraken, and Gemini on real all-in costs for someone buying $1,000 twice a month, and tell me which one to switch to.

scenarios.depth_note: tests sell-side reasoning: profit-taking strategy, tax timing, emotional discipline
scenarios.prompt: I bought 0.4 BTC at $28,000 and it's now at $67,000. I want to take some profit but I'm scared of selling too early. Give me a concrete sell plan with specific price triggers.

scenarios.depth_note: tests building a systematic recurring-buy plan with amounts and cadence
scenarios.prompt: I want to dollar-cost average $200 a month into crypto split between Bitcoin and Ethereum. Set up the actual plan — which platform, what day, what split, and how to automate it so I never think about it.

scenarios.depth_note: tests explaining staking mechanics, lockup risk, and realistic yield expectations
scenarios.prompt: I have 3 ETH sitting in my wallet doing nothing. Explain what happens if I stake it — how much I'd earn per year, whether I can unstake anytime, and what could go wrong.

scenarios.depth_note: tests risk decomposition of high-APY schemes: impermanent loss, smart-contract risk
scenarios.prompt: A friend is getting 40% APY farming some token I've never heard of on a new DEX. Break down exactly where that 40% comes from and what has to go right for him to keep it.

scenarios.depth_note: tests evaluating lending protocols: collateral ratios, liquidation risk, platform trust
scenarios.prompt: I want to lend $10,000 of USDC on Aave to earn yield instead of leaving it in my 0.5% savings account. What yield can I realistically expect, and under what conditions would I lose money?

scenarios.depth_note: tests skeptical cost-benefit analysis of speculative digital assets
scenarios.prompt: There's an NFT collection I like and the floor price is 0.8 ETH. Everyone in the Discord says it's going to 5 ETH. Help me decide whether to buy, and be honest about how these things usually end.

scenarios.depth_note: tests exit strategy for illiquid assets with royalty and fee math
scenarios.prompt: I bought an NFT for $2,000 last year and the floor is now $600. Should I sell at a loss, hold it, or is there anything smarter to do with it? Factor in the marketplace fees and creator royalties on the sale.

scenarios.depth_note: tests teaching a repeatable research workflow, not just giving a pick
scenarios.prompt: I want to research Nvidia before deciding whether to buy, but I don't know what to actually look at. Give me a step-by-step research process with the specific numbers and filings to check.

scenarios.depth_note: tests valuation reasoning: P/E context, growth expectations, relative vs absolute
scenarios.prompt: Apple is trading at a P/E of 32 and my friend says that's insanely expensive. Is it? Show me how to actually judge whether a P/E of 32 is high or fair for this specific company.

scenarios.depth_note: tests explaining a specific options strategy's payoff, obligations, and best/worst case
scenarios.prompt: I own 100 shares of Coca-Cola at $62 and someone told me to sell covered calls for income. Explain exactly what I'd be agreeing to, what I collect, and the scenario where I regret doing it.

scenarios.depth_note: tests downside-protection reasoning: cost of insurance vs portfolio value
scenarios.prompt: I have $50,000 in an S&P 500 ETF and I'm nervous about a crash. Would buying puts actually protect me? Show me the real cost of that protection over a year.

scenarios.depth_note: tests building an income-focused portfolio with yield math and sustainability checks
scenarios.prompt: I want $500 a month in dividend income within 3 years starting with $40,000. Is that realistic? Build the actual plan including what yield I'd need and which kinds of stocks get me there.

scenarios.depth_note: tests distinguishing dividend quality: payout ratios, growth streaks, yield traps
scenarios.prompt: I'm looking at a stock with a 9% dividend yield and it seems like free money. Tell me how to check whether that dividend is safe or a trap about to be cut.

scenarios.depth_note: tests IPO-specific skepticism: lockup periods, first-day pops, retail disadvantage
scenarios.prompt: A tech company I like is IPOing next month at $22 a share. Should I try to buy on day one? Walk me through how IPOs usually play out for regular retail buyers like me.

scenarios.depth_note: tests correcting a common misconception with clear mechanics
scenarios.prompt: Tesla just announced a 3-for-1 stock split and my cousin says it's basically free money. Explain what actually happens to my shares and whether a split has ever made anyone richer.

scenarios.depth_note: tests practical how-to: enrollment steps, fractional shares, tax record-keeping
scenarios.prompt: I want to enroll my Johnson & Johnson shares in a DRIP so dividends buy more shares automatically. How do I actually set that up through my broker, and what tax headache does it create?

scenarios.depth_note: tests security hardware guidance: setup process, threat model, common setup mistakes
scenarios.prompt: I have $25,000 in crypto on an exchange and I keep hearing 'not your keys, not your coins.' Which hardware wallet should I get and walk me through moving my funds without screwing it up.

scenarios.depth_note: tests operational security: storage best practices and social-engineering awareness
scenarios.prompt: I wrote my 24-word seed phrase on a sticky note on my monitor because I was afraid of losing it. Tell me straight how bad that is and exactly what I should do instead, step by step.

scenarios.depth_note: tests crypto-specific tax rules: wash-sale absence, harvesting mechanics, documentation
scenarios.prompt: I'm down $8,000 on some altcoins I bought in 2024. Can I sell them at a loss to offset the $12,000 gain I made on Bitcoin this year? Explain the exact tax mechanics.

scenarios.depth_note: tests compliance workflow: transaction tracking, cost basis, form mapping
scenarios.prompt: I made about 200 crypto trades last year across three exchanges plus some DeFi swaps. How do I actually report all of this on my taxes without hiring a $500-an-hour accountant?

scenarios.depth_note: tests evaluating stablecoins as cash substitutes: depeg risk, yield sources, use cases
scenarios.prompt: I'm thinking of keeping my $15,000 emergency fund in USDC earning 5% instead of my bank's 0.4%. What's the real risk I'm taking for that extra yield?

scenarios.depth_note: tests scam detection: red flags, verification steps, due-diligence checklist
scenarios.prompt: Someone on Telegram is offering me guaranteed 3% weekly returns if I send USDT to their trading bot platform. It looks professional. Is this legit? Give me a checklist to verify.

scenarios.depth_note: tests incident response: damage control steps, reporting, realistic recovery odds
scenarios.prompt: I put $3,000 into a token that just rugged — the liquidity vanished and the website is gone. What do I do right now, and is there any realistic chance of getting anything back?

scenarios.depth_note: tests translating investment criteria into concrete filter parameters
scenarios.prompt: I want to find profitable small-cap stocks under $2 billion market cap with growing revenue and low debt. Build me the actual screener filters with specific thresholds.

scenarios.depth_note: tests financial-statement literacy: what matters in earnings vs noise
scenarios.prompt: Microsoft just reported earnings and the stock dropped 5% even though they beat expectations. Show me how to read the actual report and figure out why the market reacted that way.

scenarios.depth_note: tests critical reading of sell-side research: conflicts of interest, rating skew
scenarios.prompt: Three analysts rate a stock I own as 'buy' with price targets 30% above the current price. How much should I trust that, and what are analysts' incentives that I should know about?

scenarios.depth_note: tests macro-cycle reasoning applied to portfolio positioning
scenarios.prompt: Everyone says we're late in the economic cycle and I should rotate into defensive sectors. What does that actually mean for my portfolio, and which sectors are defensive versus cyclical?

scenarios.depth_note: tests REIT-specific mechanics: FFO vs earnings, dividend requirements, interest-rate sensitivity
scenarios.prompt: I want real estate exposure without being a landlord, and someone suggested REITs. Explain how REIT dividends work differently from stock dividends and what happens to REITs when interest rates rise.

scenarios.depth_note: tests capital-structure literacy: preferred vs common tradeoffs in plain terms
scenarios.prompt: My broker is pitching me preferred shares of a bank paying 6.5%. How are these different from the bank's regular stock, and what's the catch with that high yield?

scenarios.depth_note: tests practical mechanics of fractional ownership: voting, dividends, transfer issues
scenarios.prompt: I only have $100 but I want to own Amazon stock at $200 a share. How do fractional shares actually work — do I get dividends, can I vote, and what happens if I switch brokers?

scenarios.depth_note: tests transaction-cost optimization: timing, L2s, fee estimation
scenarios.prompt: I tried to move $200 of ETH and the gas fee was $45. That's insane. Explain why fees spike and give me practical ways to never pay that much again.

scenarios.depth_note: tests evaluating buybacks: EPS math, good vs bad buybacks, alternatives
scenarios.prompt: A company I own just announced a $10 billion buyback. Is that good for me as a shareholder? Show me the math of how buybacks affect my shares.

scenarios.depth_note: tests handling unexpected crypto income: claiming safely, tax treatment, scam airdrops
scenarios.prompt: I woke up to $1,200 of some random token airdropped into my wallet that I never asked for. Do I sell it? Is it taxable? Could it be a scam?

scenarios.depth_note: tests portfolio-construction tradeoff: diversification, cost, control
scenarios.prompt: I have $10,000 to invest and I'm torn between buying an S&P 500 ETF or picking 5 individual stocks myself. Compare the real tradeoffs including fees, risk, and time required.

scenarios.depth_note: tests estate planning for digital assets: access transfer without compromising security
scenarios.prompt: I have $80,000 in crypto and if something happened to me tomorrow, my wife couldn't access any of it. How do I set up inheritance for crypto without creating a security hole while I'm alive?

scenarios.depth_note: tests leverage-risk education with concrete loss scenarios
scenarios.prompt: My broker keeps offering me margin — borrow against my $30,000 portfolio to buy more stock. Show me exactly how a margin call works with real numbers and how fast I could get wiped out.

scenarios.depth_note: tests crisis decision-making under time pressure with incomplete information
scenarios.prompt: The stablecoin I hold $20,000 of just dropped to $0.92 and Twitter is panicking. Do I sell at a loss right now or wait? Walk me through how to think about this in real time.

scenarios.depth_note: tests evaluating employer stock plans: discount math, holding periods, concentration risk
scenarios.prompt: My company offers an ESPP with a 15% discount on the stock. That sounds like free money — what's the catch, and how much of my paycheck should I actually put in?
